MINUTES

  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, AUGUST 25, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER
The regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Tuesday, August 25, 2020, at 6:02 PM in the City
Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
The invocation was led by Councilmember Trimble.

All City Councilmembers had a conflict of interest based on where they live. Numbers

Mayor Alvarado and Mayor Pro Tem Roa were recused from Agenda Item C-17 due to

project.

19.  BROWN ACT DEMAND FILED BY DANIEL ROJAS PERTAINING TO STATUS
  OF  SENIOR  ADMINISTRATIVE  ANALYST  POSITION;  RELATED
  CONSIDERATION OF A BUDGET AMENDMENT OR ELIMINATION OF
  SENIOR ADMINISTRATIVE ANALYST POSITION FROM THE AMENDED
  2019-2021 CITYWIDE BUDGET AND YEAR ONE OF THE HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS THREE-YEAR FINANCIAL PLAN; AND CONSIDERATION OF A
  BUDGET  AMENDMENT  OR  ELIMINATION  OF  ADMINISTRATIVE
  TECHNICIAN POSITION FROM THE AMENDED 2019-2021 CITYWIDE
  BUDGET AND YEAR ONE OF THE HG20-23 THREE-YEAR FINANCIAL PLAN
  COUNCIL ACTION:  (1) Receive and file report; (2) Direct City Attorney to
  send response letter per Gov. Code §54960.1(c)(2) in response to Council’s
  action; and (3) Direct City Manager to either (a) keep the Senior Administrative
  Analyst and/or Administrative Technician as full-time, or (b) eliminate those
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
AUGUST 25, 2020  PAGE 9 OF 12 - AMENDED
 C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S) – (CONTINUED)

  positions from the Budget and/or Three-Year Financial Plan, subject to the
  requirements of the respective Management and/or Rank-and-File Memorandum
  of Understanding and the Meyers-Milias Brown Act, and bring back a
  corresponding resolution to amend the Budget and/or Three-Year Financial Plan.

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, presented the staff report.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

All City Councilmembers spoke.

It was moved by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember Trimble, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to Receive and file report, Direct City Attorney to
send response letter pursuant to Government Code section 54960.1(c)(2) that while the
City Council determine that no Brown Act violation occurred, the City Council took
action to cure such action; and Direct City Manager to continue meet-and-confer
discussions with Union re Sr. Admin. Analyst and Admin. Tech positions being made
part-time, and to bring back at the next meeting a resolution for a budget amendment
for those positions, if the meet-and-confer discussions do not result in an agreement.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.
